**The question**

What part of the spec/behavior is unclear or seems wrong. Reference the spec section or violation code if you can (e.g. AXR-SPEC-1.x.md §..., `KEY_CHANGED_UNAUTHORIZED`).

**Context**

Why it matters for you: are you implementing a verifier, evaluating the trust model, comparing to another system?

> Found a soundness hole (forgeable receipt, bypassable check)? That is a security issue — see SECURITY.md.
